source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening, halothane and the classes of halogenoalkanes, printed pages 72-73.

blocks.text: Halogenoalkanes rozmarra zindagi mein bohat kaam ke hain, khaas taur par apni khaas chemical stability (mazbooti) ki wajah se. Pehle chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) refrigerants (thanda karne wale madde) aur aerosol propellants (spray ko bahar dhakelne wali gas) ke taur par istemal hote the, lekin ab in ki jagah mahol dost (eco-friendly) alternatives (mutabadil cheezein) aa rahe hain. Dawa (medicine) mein halogenated compounds taqatwar anesthetic (behosh karne wali dawa) ka kaam karte hain. Is ke ilawa yeh polymers banane mein bohat zaroori intermediates (darmiyani madde) hain, jaise pipes ke liye PVC (polyvinyl chloride) aur non-stick bartanon ke liye PTFE (Teflon).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke CFCs ki jagah 'Freons' jaise eco-friendly alternatives aa rahe hain. Lekin Freon khud CFCs ka tijarati naam (trade name) hai, maslan Freon-12 = CCl₂F₂. CFCs ki jagah asal mein HFCs (hydrofluorocarbons) jaise compounds aa rahe hain jin mein chlorine nahi hoti.

blocks.alt: Halothane ki khuli (displayed) banawat: aik carbon jis par teen F atoms (baen, oopar, neeche), doosre carbon se jura jis par oopar Cl, neeche H aur daen Br hai.
blocks.caption: Halothane ki banawat (kitab ke PDF safha 76 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Halothane ek halogenated hydrocarbon hai jo saans ke zariye diya jane wala (inhalation) taqatwar anesthetic hai. Yeh operation (surgery) ke dauran aisi behoshi lata hai jo baad mein khatam ho jati hai (reversible). Pehle chloroform aur doosre chlorinated anesthetics istemal hote the, lekin ab yeh zehreele (toxic) hone aur hifazat (safety) ke masail ki wajah se band (banned) hain.

Jab kisi alkane ke ek ya zyada hydrogen atoms ki jagah halogen atoms aa jayein to halogenoalkane banta hai. Molecule mein halogen atoms (–X) kitne hain, is ke mutabiq yeh mono, di, tri ya poly halogenoalkanes kehlate hain.

blocks.alt: Teen khuli banawatein, har aik mein carbon ke baen H aur daen X: monohalogenoalkane (oopar neeche H), dihalogenoalkane (oopar X, neeche H) aur trihalogenoalkane (oopar neeche X).
blocks.caption: Mono-, di- aur trihalogenoalkanes (kitab ke PDF safha 76 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: In mein se monohalogenoalkanes ko alkyl halides bhi kehte hain. In ka general formula R – X hai; R methyl, ethyl, propyl waghera ho sakta hai aur X halogen atom (F, Cl, Br, I) hai. Monohalogenoalkanes ko phir primary, secondary aur tertiary mein baanta (classify kiya) jata hai. Yeh is par munhasir hai ke halogen jis carbon par laga hai, woh carbon kitne doosre carbons se jura hai.
Primary halogenoalkane mein halogen aise carbon se jura hota hai jo aage sirf ek carbon atom se jura ho, ya kisi carbon se na jura ho, maslan:

blocks.alt: Teen primary halogenoalkanes dabbon mein: CH3-Cl chloromethane, CH3-CH2-Cl chloroethane aur CH3-CH2-CH2-Cl 1-chloropropane.
blocks.caption: Primary halogenoalkanes ki misalein (kitab ke PDF safha 76 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Secondary halogenoalkanes woh hain jin mein halogen wala carbon seedha do doosre carbon atoms se jura ho.

blocks.alt: 2-chloropropane: do CH3 groups CH-Cl se jure; aur 2-chlorobutane, CH3-CH(Cl)-CH2-CH3, jis mein Cl doosre carbon ke oopar hai.
blocks.caption: Secondary halogenoalkanes ki misalein (kitab ke PDF safha 76 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Tertiary halogenoalkane mein halogen wala carbon seedha teen doosre carbon atoms se jura hota hai.

blocks.alt: 2-chloro-2-methylpropane: darmiyani carbon jis ke daen Cl, baen H3C aur oopar neeche CH3 hain.
blocks.caption: Tertiary halogenoalkane ki misal (kitab ke PDF safha 76 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Pehchan ka asaan tareeqa: X wale carbon ke saath kitne carbon jure hain, gin lein. 0 ya 1 carbon = primary (1°), 2 carbons = secondary (2°), 3 carbons = tertiary (3°).

blocks.explanation: 1-chloro-2-methylpropane. Sab se lambi chain mein 3 carbons hain, Cl carbon 1 par aur methyl group carbon 2 par hai. Cl wala carbon (CH₂) sirf ek carbon se jura hai, is liye yeh primary chloride hai.

blocks.prompt: b) C₅H₁₁Cl formula ke tamam structures banayein aur har ek ko primary, secondary ya tertiary chloride batayein.
blocks.explanation: Aath (8) structures hain. Primary: CH₃CH₂CH₂CH₂CH₂Cl (1-chloropentane), ClCH₂CH(CH₃)CH₂CH₃ (1-chloro-2-methylbutane), (CH₃)₂CHCH₂CH₂Cl (1-chloro-3-methylbutane), (CH₃)₃CCH₂Cl (1-chloro-2,2-dimethylpropane). Secondary: CH₃CHClCH₂CH₂CH₃ (2-chloropentane), CH₃CH₂CHClCH₂CH₃ (3-chloropentane), (CH₃)₂CHCHClCH₃ (2-chloro-3-methylbutane). Tertiary: (CH₃)₂CClCH₂CH₃ (2-chloro-2-methylbutane).

items: Halogenoalkane: alkane ke H ki jagah halogen (F, Cl, Br, I); halogens ki tadaad se mono, di, tri, poly.
X wale carbon ke saath 0 ya 1 C = primary, 2 C = secondary, 3 C = tertiary.
